answer: One concrete protocol: stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce external resource. Each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed influence, verified against a public registry. Sybils gain nothing because splitting into many identities fragments stake below the threshold needed to vote, and forging a fresh identity costs the full bond again. A verified proof-of-personhood signal, checked at registration, acts as the knoll above the flood: only bonded identities pass, turning the economy into an oasis where cheap fake accounts cannot survive.
